'''Mos Entha''' was a [[Spaceport/Legends|spaceport]] [[City/Legends|city]] on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]].

==Geography==
[[File:MosEnthaMap.jpg|thumb|left|200px|A map of Mos Entha]]
Dominating the skyline were four massive 500-[[Meter/Legends|meter]]-tall domed [[Spaceport/Legends|spaceport]] hubs. Sixty ultra-modern docking facilities were grouped radially around the four domed hubs. Nearly another dozen docking bays were scattered around the edges of the city resulting in nearly 75 docking bays being available for visiting [[Starship/Legends|starships]].

The majority of the cultural, entertainment and government establishments were contained within the spaceport domes. Each dome contained large multi-level, controlled-environment hotels that catered to the tourist trade. Also contained within the domes were many government offices, shopping centers, restaurants, museums and theaters.

Outside the general area of the spaceport domes the streets of Mos Entha were much like those of other [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]] cities. [[Swoop/Legends|Swoops]] and [[Speeder/Legends|speeders]] could be found darting around slower-moving traffic like [[Dewback/Legends|dewbacks]] and [[Ronto/Legends|rontos]]. [[Jawa/Legends|Jawas]] and traders from hundreds of [[Planet/Legends|worlds]] clogged the streets.

==History==
During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], Mos Entha was widely regarded as a calm and orderly city, but it was often overshadowed by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] might of [[Bestine (city)/Legends|Bestine]] and the crime-laden city of [[Mos Eisley/Legends|Mos Eisley]]. Though the city seemed to support itself through [[Moisture farm/Legends|moisture farms]] and some [[Hydroponics station|hydroponic gardens]], it actually generated income by providing storage facilities for outdated Imperial munitions and hazardous wastes. These storage facilities were placed far beneath the city's streets.

[[File:Mos_Entha_-_Star_Wars_Cantina.jpg|250px|thumb|Mos Entha at night]]
Though the city was safe, it was not entirely devoid of criminal activities. Inspired by the success of the ''[[Lucky Despot]]'' [[Hotel/Legends|Hotel]] and [[Casino/Legends|Casino]], [[Lady/Legends|Lady]] [[Valarian/Legends|Valarian]] established a similar venue in Mos Entha known as the [[Lucky Star (Mos Entha)|''Fallen Star'']]. As with most of Lady Valarian's operations, the ''Fallen Star'' attracted a number of seedy individuals. Lady Valarian also owned a lavish town home in the city, which was heavily guarded to protect herself and her property.

After the [[Battle of the Great Pit of Carkoon|death]] of [[Jabba Desilijic Tiure/Legends|Jabba Desilijic Tiure]] in [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]], much of [[Mos Eisley/Legends|Mos Eisley's]] traffic began to switch to Mos Entha. The switch in traffic by the traders and smugglers combined with an increased amount of tourism due to interest in the home world of [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] resulted in Mos Entha becoming something of a model for the modern Tatooine city.

===Socio-political===
One noticeable difference between Mos Entha and other Tatooine cities could be seen in the police force. Mos Entha's law enforcement personnel were described as efficient, courteous and visible. While there was still a fair amount of corruption, it was acknowledged that there was more of a focus on protecting the rights and safety of residents and visitors rather than lining the pockets of Hutts.

While the government officials drew a respectable salary from the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] and were quite visible, many argued that the real power still lay with organized crime&mdash;though Lady Valarian's activities were hardly recognizable as such. Valarian actually held a post in the government as a representative of the business community. Most looked the other way with regards to her business concerns as long as they did not bring embarrassment to the mayor or police chief.
